meta.acceptance: Actual and intended organism sequences are separately documented and every handoff has an authority/correlation assessment.

detail: Decide ownership for semantic envelope, wire transport, node identity, agent identity, session identity, task identity, memory, approval, placement, delivery proof, and UI projection across Arda, Hermes A2A, MCP, and existing crates.

detail: Use Vaire policy and the existing Hermes bridge or stable programmatic API to provide scoped organism context capsules to fresh workers while preserving Hermes session authority, prompt caching, restart recovery, and ordinary conversation behavior.

meta.acceptance: A fresh worker completes and receipts a bounded task; another worker continues after gateway/root restart without prior conversation history.

detail: Converge node identity, expiring capability/pressure observations, and Arda semantic envelope mapping onto Hermes/Linux Foundation A2A; promote or replace test-only registry/routing only where the accepted authority map requires it.

meta.acceptance: Two independent nodes discover capability, exchange one authenticated correlated task/result over A2A, receipt both sides, and expire offline state honestly.

meta.acceptance: One capability request is placed across distinct resource profiles, explained by current evidence, and moves to stronger hardware without workflow rewrites.

title: Close cross-node memory, context, and learning use loops
detail: Preserve node/work/placement provenance in Vaire, enforce domain/consumer policy, emit memory-use receipts, evaluate evidence through Varda, and prove corrected cross-node continuation without transcript or secret replication.

meta.acceptance: A fresh node continues from a bounded capsule, records exact memory/evidence use, honors correction/revocation, and influences later behavior only through an approved learning receipt.

title: Implement organism homeostasis, degradation, and recovery
detail: Join direct node/service/inference/attempt/resource/memory evidence into honest organism health; enforce budgets and authority during adaptation; reconcile failures and reassign only eligible work without duplicate side effects.

meta.acceptance: A real worker/node failure is expired, reconciled, safely reassigned or stopped, visibly degraded, restart-safe, and free of duplicate terminal mutation.

title: Unify Arandur and CEO orchestration around organism authorities
detail: Audit and collapse detached CEO/autopilot surfaces into one observe, recover context, choose next action, compose roles, govern, dispatch, monitor, assess, and learn cycle that uses canonical topology, queue, memory, routing, and receipts.

meta.acceptance: Arandur completes one canonical review-record-plan-execute-assess cycle, replans from a real failure receipt, and remains stoppable and non-sovereign.

title: Run and obtain acceptance for the living-mesh proof
detail: Execute one genuine objective through at least three heterogeneous roles and two independent node boundaries, standard A2A handoff, real failure and reassignment, Varda evidence, Vaire continuation, verification, restart recovery, and source-backed topology projection.

meta.acceptance: Operator explicitly accepts the run as coherent, useful digital-organism behavior; engineering evidence alone cannot close the task.

title: Prove portable organism behavior on stronger or specialized hardware
detail: Enroll a stronger or differently constrained node using the same contracts, demonstrate evidence-backed placement improvement without workflow rewrites, remove it without loss of coherence, and project genuine read-only physical/native organism state.

meta.acceptance: A portable node manifest changes real placement and measured outcome on stronger/specialized hardware; removal degrades honestly and requires no semantic workflow rewrite.
